notes: Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (NRS 609.240): under-16 limits are the same in school and non-school weeks (federal 3 h/18 h/7 p.m. limits in federal.json also apply). The 16-18 11 p.m. limit applies only before school days; enforced every night of a school week (stricter); 18-year-olds not encoded.

No tip credit: 'Tips or gratuities received by employees shall not be credited as being any part of or offset against the wage rates required by this section' (Nev. Const. art. 15, § 16, https://www.leg.state.nv.us/Const/NvConst.html). No tipped_minimum_wage rule.

rules.summary: Nevada's basic minimum wage is $12.00 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)

rules.summary: Nevada requires 1.5x pay after 40 hours in a workweek.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)
citation.excerpt: Premium Pay After Designated Hours: Weekly - 40

rules.summary: Nevada requires 1.5x after 8 hours in a day for employees earning less than 1.5x the state minimum wage.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated Nov. 5, 2026)
citation.excerpt: Employees earning less than 1.5 times the state minimum wage are entitled to premium pay for hours worked in excess of 8 in a single day

rules.summary: Nevada requires a 30-minute meal period for work over 8 hours.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State meal-period requirements (rev. Jan. 1, 2023)
citation.excerpt: ½ hour, if work is for 8 continuous hours

rules.summary: Nevada requires a paid 10-minute rest period per 4 hours worked.

citation.title: US DOL WHD — State paid rest-period requirements (rev. Jan. 1, 2023)
citation.excerpt: Paid 10-minute rest period for each 4 hours worked or major fraction thereof

rules.summary: Children under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week.

citation.title: NRS 609.240 — Maximum hours of employment of child under 16; night limits
citation.excerpt: No child under the age of 16 years may be employed ... more than 40 hours in any 1 week, or more than 8 hours in any 1 day.

rules.summary: Children under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week.

citation.title: NRS 609.240 — Maximum hours of employment of child under 16; night limits
citation.excerpt: No child under the age of 16 years may be employed ... more than 40 hours in any 1 week, or more than 8 hours in any 1 day.

rules.summary: High school students aged 16-18 may not work between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m. on a night before a school day (exemptions by school district or court).

citation.title: NRS 609.240 — Maximum hours of employment of child under 16; night limits
citation.excerpt: between 11 p.m. and 6 a.m. on any night immediately preceding a school day if the child: (a) Is enrolled in high school ... (b) Is 16 years of age or older and under 19 years of age
